subject: Aurelia Analytics — vendor portal intake & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aurelia-analytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Security Team <security@aurelia-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding & SIG/SOC2 handoff

Hi Monica / Rishi,

Thanks for taking this — Aurelia is moving forward with Redwood for model inference and our procurement team has requested vendor portal access (we use OneTrust) so we can collect the SIG/CAIQ answers and the latest SOC 2. To keep things moving, I attached our current SIG spreadsheet with a few fields pre-filled so you can see the scope.

Three asks to start:
- Can you accept the OneTrust vendor invite (I’ll send it once you confirm contact).
- Share a redacted SOC 2 report and an S3 evidence manifest (we only need pointers to buckets/paths, not full objects).
- Confirm your data retention answer for logs and whether you have an automated log-export (brief bullets are fine).

Preferred timeline: we’re trying to close procurement checkpoints by 2027-05-18. If you need more time for the SOC2 redaction, let us know.

I attached: Aurelia_SIG_20270508.xlsx (SIG sheet).

Availability: I’m free Mon/Tue afternoons PT for a 30-minute intake.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Security Program Manager
Aurelia Analytics

Attachment: Aurelia_SIG_20270508.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aurelia-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding & SIG/SOC2 handoff

Hi Samira — thanks for the sheet and the timeline. Welcome — we’ll prioritize the intake. High-level plan from our side:

1) OneTrust invite: please send to security+vendor@redwoodinference.com — I’ll confirm once it lands and assign the portal owner.
2) SOC 2: Rishi will pull a redacted copy and mark sensitive sections before we upload.
3) Evidence manifest: Priyom will produce an S3 manifest (CSV with paths + short descriptions) and a minimal access guide for reviewers.
4) Intake call: propose Mon 2027-05-10 13:30 PT (Tue 2027-05-11 20:30 UTC) — 30 minutes.

Rishi / Priyom: can you confirm you can meet the 2027-05-18 procurement checkpoint with these artifacts? If not, call out blockers now.

A few internal notes we’ll include in the portal: list of services in scope (hosted API, dedicated pools), retention policy summary, and pointer to our observability docs. We’ll redact customer-identifying data in the SOC 2 before upload.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: onetrust-invite-link.txt (placeholder; will be replaced with real invite when received)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@aurelia-analytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding & SIG/SOC2 handoff

Samira / Monica — I pulled a redacted SOC 2 (covering 2026 report window) and started the evidence manifest. I’ve attached the redacted PDF and the preliminary s3-evidence-manifest.csv. The manifest lists buckets/paths and a short ‘proof type’ column for each entry.

Quick clarifications:
- Logs retention: default 90 days for request/trace logs; we can provide 365-day aggregated metrics on request (for enterprise contracts).
- Shared service accounts: we will provide a table of service accounts with scoped roles; permanent secrets are not in the manifest (we’ll provide proof of rotation policies instead).

I’ll be on the intake call at the time Monica suggested. Priyom, I left TODOs in the manifest for the infra team to fill owner contact for each bucket.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_SOC2_report_2026.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), s3-evidence-manifest.csv (CSV, 9KB)
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aurelia-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding & SIG/SOC2 handoff

On Mon, 10 May 2027 at 09:45, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Samira / Monica — I pulled a redacted SOC 2 (covering 2026 report window) and started the evidence manifest. I’ve attached the redacted PDF and the preliminary s3-evidence-manifest.csv.

Thanks Rishi — that looks good. A couple quick Qs before the call:
- For the 90-day logs, is that rolling retention or hard-delete after 90 days? We need to capture the retention behavior in the portal.
- For the aggregated 365-day metrics, can you confirm whether they include prompt-level (text) data or only telemetry/usage counts? If prompt-level text is excluded, we’re good.

We’ll accept the OneTrust invite once it’s sent; I’ll post the calendar hold after you confirm the intake time.

Best,
Samira

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aurelia-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding & SIG/SOC2 handoff

Samira — great questions; answers below and next steps.

1) Retention behavior: 90 days is rolling retention by default (objects become eligible for deletion after 90 days). For enterprise contracts we can configure export/archival rules — we’ll document both behaviors in the portal entry.

2) Aggregated metrics: the 365-day aggregated metrics are telemetry-only (counts, latency histograms, error rates). Prompt-level text is NOT included in the exported aggregated metrics set. Any prompt-level storage/export is handled separately and would be explicitly documented if in-scope.

Next steps (action owners):
- Monica: send OneTrust invite once vendor email confirmed (I’ll send from security+vendor@redwoodinference.com).
- Rishi: finalize redacted SOC2 and update manifest with owner contacts (ETA 2027-05-12).
- Priyom: produce final S3 manifest and a short readme describing how external reviewers can request temporary object access (ETA 2027-05-13).

Intake meeting confirmed: Mon 2027-05-10 13:30 PT (calendar invite sent). I’ll include a short agenda (30 min): introductions, scope in portal, SOC2/SIG artifacts, follow-on evidence handoff timeline.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing the procurement milestone on 2027-05-18.

Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: onetrust-invite-link.txt, s3-evidence-manifest.csv, redacted_SOC2_report_2026.pdf
